name: Türkiye
shortSummary: India-Türkiye relations are strained by Ankara's consistent vocal support for Pakistan's position on Kashmir at international forums and its defence ties to Islamabad, with tensions sharpening further in 2025.
complexity: President Erdogan's repeated references to Kashmir in UN General Assembly speeches, and Türkiye's reported military and drone supplies to Pakistan — including during 2025 India-Pakistan tensions — have kept political relations cool, prompting an informal Indian consumer boycott of Turkish tourism and trade despite continued bilateral consultations.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: India's 2023 earthquake relief effort was among its largest overseas disaster-response deployments.
Bilateral trade has continued despite political friction.
Foreign-ministry-level consultations have continued through the tension, keeping a formal diplomatic channel open.

majorChallenges.title: Türkiye-Pakistan defence ties
majorChallenges.description: Türkiye's consistent diplomatic support and reported defence supply relationship with Pakistan strains ties with India, particularly during periods of India-Pakistan tension.

majorChallenges.title: Consumer-level boycott sentiment
majorChallenges.description: A 2025 informal Indian boycott of Turkish tourism and goods reflects how far public sentiment has soured alongside official relations.

recentDevelopments.title: Tensions sharpen over Türkiye-Pakistan defence ties
recentDevelopments.description: Reports of Turkish-origin drones and matériel linked to Pakistan during a period of heightened India-Pakistan tension drew sharp criticism in India, alongside an informal consumer-level boycott movement affecting Turkish tourism and trade.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Pushed an already-cool political relationship toward its most strained point in years, with defence-related distrust now compounding the long-standing dispute over Kashmir statements.

recentDevelopments.title: Bilateral consultations resume
recentDevelopments.description: Despite the tension, foreign-ministry-level bilateral consultations between India and Türkiye continued during the year, keeping a formal diplomatic channel open.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: A sign that both sides are managing the strain through diplomatic channels rather than severing engagement entirely — evidence the relationship is strained but not fully ruptured.

recentDevelopments.title: Operation Dost earthquake relief
recentDevelopments.description: India sent search-and-rescue teams and humanitarian assistance to Türkiye after the devastating February 2023 earthquakes.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: A rare recent instance of warmth in an otherwise cool relationship, though it did not translate into a broader political thaw in subsequent years.

historicalEvents.title: Erdogan's UNGA Kashmir Remarks
historicalEvents.description: President Erdogan raises Kashmir at the UN General Assembly, drawing formal Indian protest.

historicalEvents.title: Operation Dost Earthquake Relief
historicalEvents.description: India dispatches search-and-rescue teams and humanitarian aid to Türkiye following the devastating February 2023 earthquakes, under "Operation Dost."
historicalEvents.impact: Provided a rare moment of warmth in an otherwise cool political relationship.

historicalEvents.title: Drone Supply Reports Deepen Distrust
historicalEvents.description: Reports of Turkish-origin drones and matériel linked to Pakistan during a period of heightened India-Pakistan tension draw sharp criticism in India, alongside an informal consumer-level boycott of Turkish tourism and trade.
historicalEvents.impact: Pushed the relationship to its most strained point in years, compounding the long-standing dispute over Kashmir statements.

multilateralRelations.detail: Frequent divergence on South Asia-related resolutions.
